poll.source_locator: Q6 Senate vote: Pappas 51, Sununu 43, Someone else 1, Undecided 4, will not vote 0
poll.notes: Undecided voters asked their preference and allocated (per question note), so classed LEANERS. Release date per Wikipedia (Oct 6); document is undated. 270toWin lists n=1,519; document says 1,520.

pollster.weighting_quote: The sample was weighted to gender, age, in-state geography (using the current New Hampshire voter list), party registration, and imputed education, 2024 presidential vote, and past Senate vote.
